summary: This process outlines how to create a new item in the inventory system. It involves entering item details, assigning the item to an existing item group, and the option to create a new item group if the required one does not exist.
steps: Click on 'Create' in the Item Masters section.
If the required Item Group does not exist, click the icon to create a new Item Group.
Enter the new Item Group name.
Select 'Primary' or an existing parent group (e.g., 'pens' under 'stationary data').
business_rules: The Item Code field is non-mandatory.
Every item must be assigned to an Item Group.
Item Groups can be nested (e.g., 'ball pens' under 'pens', and 'pens' under 'stationary data').
important_notes: Item codes can be used to differentiate between similar items (e.g., two types of erasers).
The system allows for the creation of new item groups directly from the item creation interface if needed.
